    Operations: insertion, deletion, substitution, and transposition of two adjacent characters.

WITH normalized_subs AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        start,
        CASE
            WHEN finish IS NULL THEN '9999-12-31'
            ELSE finish
        END AS finish
    FROM subs
),
ordered_subs AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        start,
        finish,
        LAG(finish) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY start, finish) AS prev_finish
    FROM normalized_subs
),
marked_subs AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        start,
        finish,
        CASE
            WHEN prev_finish IS NULL THEN 1
            WHEN start <= date(prev_finish, '+1 day') THEN 0
            ELSE 1
        END AS is_new_group
    FROM ordered_subs
),
grouped_subs AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        start,
        finish,
        SUM(is_new_group) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY start, finish) AS grp
    FROM marked_subs
)
SELECT
    user_id,
    MIN(start) AS start,
    MAX(finish) AS finish
FROM grouped_subs
GROUP BY user_id, grp
ORDER BY user_id, start;
```

WITH RECURSIVE reports AS (
    SELECT 
        id AS manager_id,
        id AS staff_id
    FROM staff
    WHERE manager_id IS NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        r.manager_id,
        s.id
    FROM staff s
    JOIN reports r ON s.manager_id = r.staff_id
)

    s.name,
    COUNT(r.staff_id) AS reports
FROM staff s
JOIN reports r ON s.id = r.manager_id
WHERE r.staff_id != s.id
GROUP BY s.id, s.name
HAVING COUNT(r.staff_id) >= 1
ORDER BY reports DESC, s.name ASC;
